items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: naturally, he used to call me Steel -- Steel Chest. ... we had names for one another.

ctx.x: Count Basie fought himself through that crowd and those heathen women, they wanted him to sign anything they

brought to him, just put your name on it. And he was trying to evade them, even toilet tissue, anything, napkins, anything. Count said, no, I don't sign no toilet tissues and no napkins. Well, that's taking advantage of a man. Want to rest and take it easy during his intermission, and those women were playing on him and pulling on him, trying to stop him.
But he came over to the table, and he -- naturally, he used to call me Steel -- Steel Chest.
